comparison.objective: Sort six kitchen items into rule-specific bins; candidate fractures four installed insert tangs and recovers the fragments.
comparison.physical_skill: Item classification, cross-body transport and handoffs versus coaxial mandrel alignment, bimanual hammering, force regulation and tiny-fragment recovery.

comparison.reason: The record tests semantic sorting and transport, not controlled impact fracture or post-fracture recovery.
